title: 第八章 放狗咬人！
content_zh:
王大壮赶紧别过脸去，心跳如擂鼓。

    可越是不看，心里头就越痒痒，那团火烧得他浑身难受。

    他想到了洞里的一切。

    反正都发生过了，嫂子早就是他的人了。

    这个念头一出来，王大壮像是被什么东西驱使着一般，站起身来，三两步走到李玉梅身后，伸手从背后环住了李玉梅的腰。

    李玉梅身体猛地一僵，锅铲都顿住了。

    “别闹……炒菜呢……”她声音发软，带着一丝娇嗔。

    可王大壮的手却不安分起来，顺着她的腰线缓缓游走。

    李玉梅瞬间就崩溃了，整个人软得像是要站不住，手里的锅铲差点掉进锅里。

    王大壮凑到她耳边，轻声道：“嫂子，我都记起来了，包括在洞里发生的一切，现在大哥不在了，以后就由我来照顾你。”

    说完，他捧住李玉梅的脸，直接吻了下去。

    李玉梅起初还挣扎了一下，但很快就沦陷了，转过身搂住王大壮的脖子，两人在灶台前深情拥吻。

    灶膛里的火烧得正旺，锅里的菜滋滋作响，整个灶房里弥漫着一种暧昧而炙热的气息。

    好一会儿，李玉梅才猛地推开王大壮，喘着气说道：“大壮，不行……现在不行，要是被人看到会说闲话的。”

    王大壮看着她红透了的脸和微微肿起的嘴唇，心里头明白她说得有道理。

    这村子不大，东家长西家短的，有点风吹草动就能传得满村风雨。

    李玉梅一个寡妇，要是被人知道跟小叔子有那种关系，唾沫星子都能把她淹死。

    “行，那就偷摸的。”王大壮想了想，笑嘻嘻道：“等我有出息了，我看谁还敢在背后嚼舌根。”

    李玉梅听到这话，眼眶又红了，心里头又酸又暖，重重地点了点头。

    就在这时，院子门口忽然传来一阵凶猛的狗叫声。
content_en:
Wang Dazhuang quickly turned away, his heart beating like a drum.

    But the more he didn't look at it, the more itchy his heart became, and the fire made his whole body uncomfortable.

    He thought about everything in the cave.

    Anyway, it has happened, and his sister-in-law has long been his.

    As soon as this thought came out, Wang Dazhuang seemed to be driven by something. He stood up, walked behind Li Youmei in a few steps, and put his arms around Li Youmei's waist from behind.

    Li Youmei's body stiffened suddenly, and the spatula stopped.

    "Don't make trouble... I'm cooking..." Her voice was soft, with a hint of coquettishness.

    But Wang Dazhuang's hand became restless and slowly wandered along her waistline.

    Li Youmei collapsed in an instant, her whole body was so weak that she seemed to be unable to stand, and the spatula in her hand almost fell into the pot.

    Wang Dazhuang leaned close to her ear and whispered: "Sister-in-law, I remember everything, including everything that happened in the cave. Now that eldest brother is gone, I will take care of you from now on."

    After saying that, he held Li Youmei's face and kissed her directly.

    Li Youmei struggled for a while at first, but soon gave in. She turned around and hugged Wang Dazhuang's neck, and the two kissed passionately in front of the stove.

    The fire in the stove was burning brightly, the vegetables in the pot were sizzling, and the entire stove was filled with an ambiguous and hot atmosphere.

    After a while, Li Youmei suddenly pushed Wang Dazhuang away and gasped: "Dazhuang, no... not now. If someone sees him, he will gossip."

    Wang Dazhuang looked at her red face and slightly swollen lips, and knew in his heart that she was right.

    The village is not big, the east is long and the west is short, so the slightest disturbance can spread throughout the village.

    Li Youmei was a widow, and if anyone found out that she had that kind of relationship with her brother-in-law, she would be drowned by spittle.

    "Okay, let's do it secretly." Wang Dazhuang thought for a while and said with a smile: "When I become successful, I'll see who dares to gossip behind my back."

    When Li Youmei heard this, her eyes turned red again, her heart felt sour and warm, and she nodded heavily.

    At this moment, a fierce dog barking suddenly came from the door of the yard.
